title: Java Developer--Quest Global-Trivandrum
description:
4+ years of experience in design and development of software applications and frameworks. Strong experience in developing Linux/Unix based desktop applications using Core Java. Strong experience in UI development using Java Swing. Experience in Spring/Spring Boot. Hands on experience in Angular. Hands on experience in using HTML, CSS and Javascript. Medical Device development experience. Deep knowledge in Object-Oriented concepts and experience in implementing the same using Java. Unit testing experience using JUnit or similar. Excellent analytical, problem solving and debugging skills. Good knowledge of software design patterns and UML. Experience in developing software applications for Medical Devices domain CT, XR, MR, Common Platform, DICOM standard. Hands-on experience in RDBMS and SQL. Excellent communication skills. Desired Skills: Very good knowledge of TCP/IP networking and network services such as DNS, SMTP, DHCP, FTP, SSH, Telnet, etc. Familiar with tools like WinScp, Putty, Rally, ClearQuest, Clearcase, Collaborator, SVN, ALM, JDICOM/DVT/DCMTK. Ability to explore large code base and understand architecture and design. Ability to deliver without much supervision from lead/managers. Proficiency with MS Office, particularly MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint.

Key Skills: Java,spring,Microservices
